title: Late Cancellation Penalties on Room Reservations
content:
## Policy

(a) A late cancellation penalty on a Room Reservations reservation is charged only when the reservation's recorded cancellation timing is after the deadline.

(b) A penalty is posted only on a reservation whose status is cancelled.

(c) The penalty basis is the plan's late cancellation basis, and the plan's figure for whether tax is added to a cash penalty applies with it.

(d) **No longer in force.** The former clause "under the first-night basis the penalty is one night at the reservation's nightly rate plus tax at the hotel's tax rate; under the full-stay basis it is every night of the stay at the nightly rate plus tax; tax is added only when the plan adds tax to penalties" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis for the penalty a late cancellation owes.

(e) Under the first night points basis no cash penalty is charged: the points or the Free Night Award paying the first night are retained and the rest of the redemption is returned under the Ashbury Rewards and Free Night Award rules.

(f) The nightly rate and nights are those on the reservation at the moment of cancellation, after any change or Best Rate Guarantee adjustment.

(g) When the reservation's guarantee is an advance deposit or a full prepayment, the penalty is settled from the money held, with settlement recorded against the advance deposit, and any money held beyond the penalty is refunded to the card; otherwise the penalty is charged to the card on file.

(h) A reservation carries at most one cancellation penalty or no-show charge, as the reservation's charge records show.

(i) A timely cancellation never carries a penalty.

## Settlement at a glance

| Guarantee on the reservation | Where the penalty is settled | Money held beyond the penalty |
|---|---|---|
| Advance deposit | From the money held | Refunded to the card |
| Full prepayment | From the money held | Refunded to the card |
| Credit card | Charged to the card on file | — |

## Points of judgement

- **Cancellation recorded before the deadline:** no penalty, whatever the plan (a), (i).
- **Reward Night Rate reservation cancelled after the deadline:** no cash penalty; the first night's points or Free Night Award are retained (e).
- **Reservation that already carries a no-show charge:** no cancellation penalty is added (h).
- **Rate lowered by a Best Rate Guarantee adjustment before the cancellation:** the adjusted nightly rate is the one the penalty reads (f).

superseded_clauses: Under first_night_room_and_tax the penalty is one night at the reservation's nightly rate plus tax at tax_rate_pct; under full_stay_room_and_tax it is every night of the stay at the nightly rate plus tax; tax is added only when penalty_includes_tax is true.
